easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Crusher such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
description:
Kill Arcbound Crusher.
When Arcbound Crusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Crusher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Crusher dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
